newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK gold closes slightly firmer at day's high.
newsitem.headline: HK gold closes slightly firmer at day's high.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed slightly firmer at the day's high on Monday after trading within a 30 U.S. cent range in an extremely quiet session, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$342.60/343.10 an ounce against New York's US$342.35/85 close on Friday.
"The market players were shortcovering, believing that gold had seen its lowest point and was recovering," said a dealer at a local investment house.
"But the market retained its bearish mantle and the price of gold will keep to the range within US$340-345."
Traders also noted players were mostly staying away due to market holidays on Monday in the United States and the United Kingdom.
Local gold ended HK$2 higher at HK$3,169 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to +0.99 from its previous fix at nil.
